name: phone_urgent
text: A person paces back and forth while talking urgently on the phone held at the right ear. Walk a few steps, turn around, walk back, then turn again. The right hand keeps the phone at the ear.

runtime.note: Runtime pose and object tracks are the final interaction. Source NPZ alone does not encode those contacts or object motion.

repair.method: Reconstruct all77 joints from archived pre-EE local rotations and complete hierarchy; author complete anatomical arm chains for task grips where needed.
repair.original_body_root_legs: Preserved from the archived original full motion; no temporal smoothing or selected-frame freezing.
repair.derivatives: global/local rotations and posed77 joints reconstructed together; archived root path, foot contacts and heading retained; loop final rotations/contacts/heading repeat first.
